author: bardic-inspiration
name: Shriekwing Bat
summary: A leather-winged cave bat whose scream is loud enough to knock a torchbearer's ears ringing.
description: Shriekwings roost by the thousand in vaulted caverns, and the guano beneath them is the first sign a traveler is close. A colony disturbed at once is a wall of noise; caravans crossing their halls go in silence, with rags over the lamps. The bats themselves are nearly deaf to everything but their own voices.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: The bat can't use its Blindsight while it has the {ref:condition/deafened} condition.

actions.name: Shriek
actions.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/deafened} condition until the end of the bat's next turn.
